title: Atkore Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-08
summary: Atkore Inc. filed an 8-K on April 8, 2026, disclosing the sale of its High-Density Polyethylene (HDPE) pipe and conduit business to Infra Pipes, a North American polyethylene pipeline solutions provider. The filing references an attached press release (Exhibit 99.1) for details. No transaction terms or financial terms are provided in the 8-K body.
